description: This file defines callback configuration data, including interfaces, constants, and utility functions for managing callback integrations within the project.

classes.name: CallbackConfig
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of callback configuration objects, including identifiers, display names, logos, supported features, dynamic parameters, and descriptions.

methods.name: mapDisplayToInternalNames
methods.description: Maps an array of display names to internal callback IDs using the callback_map.

methods.name: mapInternalToDisplayNames
methods.description: Maps an array of internal callback IDs to their display names using the reverse_callback_map.

methods.name: getCallbackById
methods.description: Retrieves a callback configuration object by its internal ID.

methods.name: getCallbackByDisplayName
methods.description: Retrieves a callback configuration object by its display name.
